answer: Reaching eligibility takes 54 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. The ocean register is checked at draw time, willow lists the eligible set, and wharf seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 54 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 358 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
